text: Hemaana dabboy Asaafi iya ushacha baggara eqidi oothees. Asaafi Baraka na7a; Baraka Sim7a na7a;
Enta sunthay haysafe kaallidi xaafetis. Benihuuri derey dariya Efreema biitta ayseysa.

Benihadad Akaabako, “Ta aaway ne aawape ekida katamata ta new zaarana. Ta aaway Samaaren giya essidaysada neka Damasqon giya essa” yaagis. Akaabi zaaridi, “Taani ha caaquwa gaasoyada nena yeddana” yaagis. Iyara caaqidi iya yeddis.
Iyosaafexi asaara zoretidaape guye, “Godaa galatite, iya siiqoy merinaasa” yaagidi yexishenne iya geeshsha bonchuwa sabbishe olanchota sinthara biya asata shuumis.
Akaazi Xoossa keethafe, kawo gadhopenne halaqatape darobaa ekidi, Asoore kawas immis. Shin hessi iya aykoka maaddibeenna.
Hizqiyaasas daro duretethinne bonchoy de7ees. Hizqiyaasi ba bira, worqaa, al7o shuchaa, sawo, gondallenne hara al7o miishe ubbaa minjiya keethi keexis.
Abrahaame, Yisaaqa, Yayqooba Xoossay, nu aawata Xoossay, ba na7aa Yesuusa bonchis. Shin hinte hayqos aathidi immidaysa Philaxoosi billanaw koyinka hinte iya sinthan, ‘Nuuni iya eroko’ yaagideta.
Goday iyako, “Dendada Suure geetetiya ogiya bada, Yihuda son Saa7ola geetetiya Tarsesape yida uraa koya; Saa7oli woossees.
He qoncethay Xoossay koyro doorida markatasafe attishin, asa ubbaasa gidenna. I hayqope dendidaape guye iyara midanne uyida.
Enti irxaba ubbaa midi wursida wode taani, “Abeeti, Ubbaa Haariya Godaw, hayyana ne deriya maararki! Yayqooba zareti waanidi attanaw danda7oona? Enti ubba guutha!” yaagas.
Godaape laata woyto oothidi hinte ekeysa erite; hinte Godaa Kiristoosa haggaazeeta.
Iyara caaquwa caaqi simmidi, ba oothiyaba cimon oothana; guutha asata xalaalara I minnana.
I ma7idi aqana mela sa7i omarsiya wode iyaw guye zaara; I nena galatana. Hessi Godaa ne Xoossaa sinthan new xillotetha ooso gididi taybetana.
Goday ba wolqaama kushiyan, ba micetida qesiyan, gita dagaman, malaataninne malaalsiyabatan nuna Gibxefe kessis.
Godaa, hinte Xoossara qaala gelanaw haysan eqideta. Goday ha qaala hachi hintera caaqon minthana.
Nabbabetida taariketape issoy Mardikiyoosi oothidaba. Hessika, kawoy de7iya kifiliya naagiya, Gabatanne Taara geetetiya nam7u shuufati kawa wodhanaw maqida maquwa Mardikiyoosi qoncisis.
Shin Musey, “Ta inxarsay lufa. Isra7eeleti tana si7ibookona, shin Gibxe kawoy tana waanidi si7anee?” yaagis.
Ne sidhene, ne haythan worqa, ne huuphen lo77o kallacha wothas.
Gado! Gado! Taani ha katamaa dhaysana. Pirdanaw maati de7eysi yaana gakanaw ha katamay zaaridi keexetenna. I yaa wode ta iyaw aathada immana” yaagees.
“Asa na7aw, ta nena Isra7eele asaas wochiya asi oothas; ta new odeysa si7ada asaa akeekisa.
Oyddu maazanetan de7iya dabaabati issi gina; enti oytamu wadha adusse; hastamu wadha orde.
Qaynani Malal7eela yelidaape guye, 840 laythi de7is. Hara adde naytanne macca nayta yelis.

He wode Sidima zangaaran madeda oykiyabati de7iya ollati de7oosona. Soodome kawoynne Gamoora kawoti olape attanaw baqatishe he ollan wullidosona. Shin hanko heedzu kawotethati zumako baqatidi attidosona.
Iya, “Taani Batu7eela na7a; Batu7eeli Milka Naakoras yelida na7a.
Neeni ha7i betetethan uttida ha biitta nebaa oothana mela newunne ne sheeshas Xoossay Abrahaame anjuwa immo” yaagi anjidi kiittis.
Taani beniysada ne halaqata, koyroysada ne zoranchota denthana. Hessafe guye, neeni ammanetida biitta; xillotetha Katama geetetana” yaagees.
Hessa gisho, Goday Xiyoone maccasa huuphiya dhuusan kunthana; Goday enta huuphiya bo77ayana” yaagees.

Goday taako haysada yaagees; Neeni Yayqooba kochaa denthanaw Isra7eelepe attida guuthata zaarada ehanaw neeni taw aylle gideysi daro guuthaba. Hessafe aathada, ta atotethay biitta gaxa gakana mela taani nena kawotethatas poo7o oothana.
He katamaa giddon issi mino adussa gimbey de7ees. Katamaa asay macci, addey, kaaletheysatinne hara asa ubbay attonna woxidi adussa gimbiya giddo gelidosona. Pengiya gordidi gimbiya huuphe keyidosona.
Goday, “Neeni like be7adasa. Taka ta qaala polanaw haysada be7ayis” yaagis.
“Ermiyaasa, ha asaas tana aykoka woossofa; enta gisho gaannatopa woyko oychofa. Enti banta metuwa gallas tana xeegiya wode ta enta si7ike.
“Ubbaafe Wolqaama Goday, Isra7eele Xoossay, Yerusalaamepe Babiloone di7etida asa ubbaas haysada yaagees:
Taani hintew tuma odayis; ta qaala naagiya oonika hayqenna” yaagis.
Nabiya Isayaasi, “Godaw, nu markatethaa ooni ammanidee? Goday ba wolqaa ooddes qoncisidee?” Gidaysi tuma gidana mela enti iya ammanibookona.
Xoossas yayyonna asaa kochay dhayana; wodhaafen keexetida keethay taman meetetana.
Neeni kathaafe bayra Godaas ehiya wode caacetidi shirketida tiya gidanaw bessees.
Kahiney hessa Godaas xuussa yarsho oothidi yarsho bessan xuuggo.
Hospuntha gallas Musey Aarona, iya adde naytanne Isra7eele cimata xeegis.
Wolqaama kawota araatape kawushis; bantana kawushidaysata kaaboyis.
Yaatidi iya miisheta ubbaa liiqo galban kammidi tookiya arsa bolla wothona.
Iitati banta iita ooson kundana; shin xillotas hayqope attiya miixi de7ees.
Iita asati, tana ixeysatinne ta morketi tana wodhanaw hordofiya wode, bantaw dhubetidi kundana.
Ta madunthaa gaason ta shoorotinne ta laggeti haakidi eqidosona; ta dabboti taape haakidosona.
Nu aawati Gibxen de7iya wode, malaalsiya ne oosuwa qopibookona. Ne siiquwa darotethaa enti hassaybookona; Zo7o abba matan iya bolla makallidosona.
Salonne sa7aa medhida, Godaa sunthan nuus maadoy yees.
Taani biya bessaanne shempiya bessaa xomoosasa; ta ogeta ubbaa eraasa.
Doloha bagga paallada biiko, woyko wuloha baggan haakada de7iko,
Abba gaxan de7iya shafiyan eqis.
Nu xammaqetida wode Kiristoosara hayqidanne moogetida. Kiristoosi Xoossaa Aawa boncho wolqan hayqope dendidaysa mela nuka ooratha de7on daana.
Kiitetonaysati, pathonna oda odeteysati, cimmeysati ubbaka qaxaretetha wogaa naagiya daro asati de7oosona.
